name: Family Reunification Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse, unmarried cohabiting partner with a shared child, minor child, incapacitated adult child, dependent parent, or ward of a Moldovan citizen or a foreign resident sponsor.
Proof of housing (ownership or registered lease); for foreign sponsors, income of at least one average monthly salary per family member.

sources.title: Bureau for Migration and Asylum (legacy igm.gov.md domain) -- notification of family reunification: eligible family members, housing/income requirements, 10-working-day examination, 288 MDL fee, 4 regional filing centres (Chisinau, Balti, Comrat, Cahul), 3-year path to permanent residence if married to a Moldovan citizen

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Moldova). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 Bureau for Migration and Asylum sourced. pr_after_months (36) and citizenship_after_months (36) reflect the accelerated 3-year track available specifically for a foreign spouse married to a Moldovan citizen -- see md_permanent_residence.json and md_citizenship_by_marriage.json for the underlying sourcing of those figures; not every family-reunification beneficiary qualifies for the 3-year track (e.g. a dependent parent or ward does not), so these fields describe the fastest available path via this route, not a universal one.
